coverage_assessment: Open-web research completed for 17 recorded queries with 337 captured result headers (not total search-result counts): general English/Arabic, five weekly windows in both languages, labor/student terms, December/UNAMID boundary, February El Geneina follow-up, regional cities and a targeted bread-price check. 75 source cards preserve opened bodies, search-only leads, blocked items and retrieval limitations. January evidence covers Khartoum, Darfur, Blue Nile, South Kordofan, North Kordofan, Atbara and El Gedaref; other regions were queried, but search results do not establish absence. Crowd sizes, local unit boundaries and some dates remain unresolved. No human Arabic translation or independent double-coding was performed; open-web coverage is not LexisNexis-equivalent and is not exhaustive. Official baseline remains pending.
timestamp_note: started_at and first_observed_at are the actual UTC clock reading immediately before initialization; query timestamps will be recorded from clock readings immediately before each web request.
